events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Ronny Simon raced home on Spencer Horwitz's eighth inning sacrifice fly and the Pittsburgh Pirates assured themselves of the club's first non-losing season in eight years with a 2-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates beat the Cardinals 2-1 to secure their first non-losing season since 2018

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — The Chicago White Sox became the first team to follow consecutive 100-loss seasons by reaching the playoffs on Thursday, throttling the Kansas City Royals 9-1 to ensure no worse than one of the three AL wild-card spots for the postseason.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox clinch a playoff spot with a 9-1 rout of the Royals after back-to-back 100-loss seasons

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong joined the 40-40 club by stealing his 40th base to go along with his major league-leading 45 home runs, and the Chicago Cubs...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs clinch 2nd straight playoffs trip by beating Marlins 2-1 as Crow-Armstrong joins 40-40 club

events.name: New York Mets at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Josh Jung and Corey Seager homered, Kumar Rocker pitched five solid innings and Texas closed out its home schedule with a 3-1 win over the New York Mets on Thursday that kept the Rangers
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers finish home slate with 3-1 win over Mets to keep Texas tied for AL West lead

headlines.description: — Gabriel Moreno and Nolan Arenado homered in a six-run first inning, and the Arizona Diamondbacks had a season-high 18 hits as they kept up their slim postseason chances with a 12-8 win over the Colorado Rockies on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: D-Backs maintain slim playoff hopes, beat Rockies 12-8 as Moreno, Arenado hit first-inning homers

headlines.description: — The Milwaukee Brewers reached 100 wins for the first time, and Jackson Chourio hit his 25th homer to lift them to a 5-1 victory over Philadelphia on Thursday night that slowed the Phillies’ playoff push.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers reach 100 wins for first time, slow Phillies' playoff push with 5-1 victory

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Angel Martínez homered and Joey Cantillo threw five one-hit innings in a bulk relief role as the Cleveland Guardians clinched a playoff spot for the third straight year with a 1-0 win over the Boston Red Sox on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians clinch a playoff spot again, edging the Red Sox 1-0 on Martínez homer

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Rookie George Lombard Jr. scored on an incredible slide and followed with a tiebreaking. two-run homer as Cam Schlitter finished his season with an...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lombard's incredible slide, tiebreaking homer lift Yanks over Rays. Schlitter finishes with 1.95 ERA

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz hit his 30th homer, Héctor Rodríguez and rookie Carlos Jorge also went deep, and the Cincinnati Reds rallied from an early deficit to beat the NL East champion Atlanta Braves 7-6 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elly De La Cruz hits 30th homer and Reds rally for 7-6 win over Braves, who lock up NL's No. 3 seed

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Christian Moore hit a two-run double and had three RBI, Bryce Teodosio drove in two runs, and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Seattle Mariners 6-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian Moore and Bryce Teodosio rally Angels past Mariners 6-4

headlines.description: — Lucas Spence hit the first three home runs of his major league career, Christian Walker and Isaac Paredes also homered, and the Houston Astros outlasted the Athletics 7-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spence hits first 3 homers of career, helps Astros survive Athletics 7-5 to keep playoff hopes alive

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. and Ethan Salas had RBI singles in a three-run seventh inning and the San Diego Padres beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-2 on Thursday night to clinch their franchise-record third consecutive postseason berth and fifth in seven seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres beat Dodgers 4-2 to clinch a franchise-record 3rd straight postseason berth
